name: Pabwehshi
sum: Pabwehshi is a baurusuchine mesoeucrocodylian from the Maastrichtian Vitakri Formation of Pakistan.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: GSP-UM 2000, a partial snout and corresponding lower jaw element.
material: The holotype and further specimens (5 PBDB occurrences).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Wilson et al. 2001
